fr.label: Tous les processus requis sont actifs

SystemUpdated.query:
SELECT DISTINCT 'pending update requires reboot' AS error \
       FROM file \
       WHERE path = '/var/run/reboot-required' \
       UNION ALL \
       SELECT 'kernel package installed since the current boot' AS error \
       FROM uptime AS u \
       WHERE EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM rpm_packages AS p \
         WHERE p.name IN ( \
           'kernel', \
           'kernel-core', \
           'kernel-default' \
         ) \
         AND p.install_time > ( \
           CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - u.total_seconds \
         ) \
       );

DriveEncryption.query:
SELECT DISTINCT '' AS error \
       FROM mounts AS m \
       LEFT JOIN disk_encryption AS d ON d.name = m.device \
       WHERE m.path = '/' \
       AND ( \
         m.device LIKE '/dev/sd%' \
         OR m.device LIKE '/dev/nvme%' \
         OR m.device LIKE '/dev/vd%' \
         OR m.device LIKE '/dev/xvd%' \
         OR m.device LIKE '/dev/mmcblk%' \
       ) \
       AND (d.name IS NULL OR d.encrypted != 1);

SystemIntegrityProtection.query:
SELECT 'missing access control (SELinux/AppArmor)' AS error \
       WHERE NOT EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM selinux_settings \
         WHERE key = 'enforce' \
         AND value = '1' \
       ) \
       AND NOT EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM apparmor_profiles \
         WHERE mode = 'enforce' \
         LIMIT 1 \
       );

Firewall.query:
SELECT '' AS error \
      WHERE NOT EXISTS ( \
        SELECT 1 \
        FROM systemd_units \
        WHERE id IN ( \
          'firewalld.service', \
          'nftables.service', \
          'iptables.service', \
          'ip6tables.service', \
          'netfilter-persistent.service', \
          'ufw.service' \
        ) \
          AND active_state = 'active' \
          AND unit_file_state IN ('enabled', 'enabled-runtime') \
      );

AutoUpdates.query:
SELECT '' AS error \
       WHERE NOT EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 FROM systemd_units \
         WHERE id IN ( \
           'dnf-automatic-install.timer', \
           'transactional-update.timer' \
         ) \
         AND active_state = 'active' \
         AND unit_file_state IN ('enabled', 'enabled-runtime') \
       ) \
       AND NOT EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 FROM systemd_units AS timer \
         WHERE timer.id = 'apt-daily-upgrade.timer' \
         AND timer.active_state = 'active' \
         AND timer.unit_file_state IN ('enabled', 'enabled-runtime') \
         AND EXISTS ( \
           SELECT 1 FROM systemd_units AS service \
           WHERE service.id = 'unattended-upgrades.service' \
           AND service.load_state = 'loaded' \
         ) \
       );

fr.label: Mises à jour automatiques sont activées

SharingPreferences.query:
SELECT 'SMB sharing is enabled' AS error \
       WHERE EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM systemd_units \
         WHERE id IN ( \
           'smb.service', \
           'smbd.service', \
           'samba.service' \
         ) \
         AND active_state = 'active' \
       ) \
       UNION ALL \
       SELECT 'NFS sharing is enabled' AS error \
       WHERE EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM systemd_units \
         WHERE id IN ( \
           'nfs-server.service', \
           'nfs-kernel-server.service' \
         ) \
         AND active_state = 'active' \
       ) \
       UNION ALL \
       SELECT 'remote Desktop (VNC/RDP) is enabled' AS error \
       WHERE EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM systemd_units \
         WHERE ( \
           id = 'xrdp.service' \
           OR id LIKE 'vncserver@%.service' \
           OR id LIKE 'tigervncserver@%.service' \
           OR id LIKE 'xvnc@%.service' \
         ) \
         AND active_state = 'active' \
       ) \
       OR EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM listening_ports AS l \
         JOIN processes AS p ON p.pid = l.pid \
         WHERE l.port != 0 \
         AND ( \
           LOWER(p.path) LIKE '%/gnome-remote-desktop%' \
           OR LOWER(p.path) LIKE '%/vino-server' \
           OR LOWER(p.path) LIKE '%/wayvnc' \
           OR LOWER(p.path) LIKE '%/x11vnc' \
           OR LOWER(p.path) LIKE '%/xvnc' \
           OR LOWER(p.path) LIKE '%/xtigervnc' \
         ) \
       ) \
       UNION ALL \
       SELECT 'remote login (SSH) is enabled' AS error \
       WHERE EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM systemd_units \
         WHERE id IN ( \
           'sshd.service', \
           'ssh.service', \
           'sshd.socket', \
           'ssh.socket', \
           'dropbear.service', \
           'dropbear.socket' \
         ) \
         AND active_state = 'active' \
       ) \
       UNION ALL \
       SELECT 'remote management (Cockpit) is enabled' AS error \
       WHERE EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM systemd_units \
         WHERE id IN ( \
           'cockpit.service', \
           'cockpit.socket' \
         ) \
         AND active_state = 'active' \
       );

GuestLogin.query:
SELECT 'Interactive account has an empty password: ' || s.username AS error \
       FROM shadow AS s \
       JOIN users AS u ON s.username = u.username \
       WHERE s.password_status = 'empty' \
       AND u.shell NOT LIKE '%nologin' \
       AND u.shell NOT LIKE '%/false';

BootOptions.query:
SELECT 'UEFI Secure Boot is disabled or unavailable' AS error \
       WHERE NOT EXISTS ( \
         SELECT 1 \
         FROM secureboot \
         WHERE secure_boot = 1 \
       ) \
       UNION ALL \
       SELECT 'insecure kernel boot parameters: ' || arguments AS error \
       FROM kernel_info \
       WHERE REGEX_MATCH( \
         LOWER(arguments), \
         '(^|[[:space:]])(selinux=0|enforcing=0|apparmor=0|security=none|init=/bin/(sh|bash)|lockdown=none)([[:space:]]|$)', \
         0 \
       ) IS NOT NULL;

RemovableStorage.query:
SELECT TRIM( \
         COALESCE(vendor, '') || ' ' || \
         COALESCE(model, '') || \
         CASE \
           WHEN serial IS NOT NULL AND serial != '' THEN ' (' || serial || ')' \
           ELSE '' \
         END \
       ) AS error \
       FROM usb_devices \
       WHERE class = 8 \
       AND removable = 1;

SensitiveFiles.query:
SELECT REPLACE(path, '/home/{{username}}/', '') AS error \
       FROM file \
       WHERE path LIKE '/home/{{username}}/Downloads/%%' \
       AND ( \
         REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), 'password.*\.(txt|xlsx?|tsv|csv|json|ya?ml|conf|ini|pdf)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(backup|recovery|access|secret|private).?(token|password|code|key).*\.(txt|xls|xlsx|tsv|csv|json|ya?ml|conf|ini)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(bitwarden|lastpass|dashlane).*export', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '\.(ppk|pfx|p12|kdbx|1pux|opvault|wallet)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(2fa|authenticator|mfa).*backup', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(wallet\.dat)(\..*)?$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), '(rootkey|credentials)\.csv$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR REGEX_MATCH(LOWER(filename), 'service.?account.*\.json$', 0) IS NOT NULL \
         OR (filename LIKE '%id_rsa%' AND filename NOT LIKE '%.pub') \
         OR (filename LIKE '%id_ed25519%' AND filename NOT LIKE '%.pub') \
         OR filename LIKE '%seed%phrase%' \
         OR filename LIKE '%mnemonic%' \
         OR filename LIKE '%wallet.dat' \
         OR filename LIKE '%azureprofile%' \
         OR filename LIKE 'client_secret%.json' \
       ) \
       AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btime, 0), mtime) <= ( \
         strftime('%s', 'now') - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60) \
       ) \
       AND filename NOT LIKE '.%';

ExportedFiles.query:
SELECT REPLACE(path, '/home/{{username}}/', '') AS error \
       FROM file \
       WHERE path LIKE '/home/{{username}}/Downloads/%%' \
       AND REGEX_MATCH( \
         LOWER(filename), \
         'export.*\.(csv|tsv|json|txt|xlsx?)(\..*)?$', \
         0 \
       ) IS NOT NULL \
       AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btime, 0), mtime) <= ( \
         strftime('%s', 'now') - (30 * 24 * 60 * 60) \
       ) \
       AND filename NOT LIKE '.%';

UnusedFiles.query:
SELECT REPLACE(path, '/home/{{username}}/', '') AS error \
       FROM file \
       WHERE directory = '/home/{{username}}/Downloads' \
       AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btime, 0), mtime) <= ( \
         strftime('%s', 'now') - (90 * 24 * 60 * 60) \
       ) \
       AND filename NOT LIKE '.%';
